title: HarvestBatch
description: The wire form of one harvest_batches row: chapter 17's HarvestBatch / CurationBatch (MOS-TRAIN-078, MOS-TRAIN-083, MOS-TRAIN-202), physical form per chapter 12 section 12.12.1 as rendered by 0011_curation.up.sql. Response body of table 10.2-B row R1. The entity is chapter 17's and is not redefined here. There is no public_id column on this table -- unlike the 0013_training tables, which carry tr_/cs_/cv_ prefixed ULIDs -- so the wire id is the row's UUIDv7 surrogate key (MOS-STORE-208).

state.description: The harvest_batches state CHECK, verbatim and in its order. Closed under MOS-API-093: adding a value is a breaking change, because a client that renders an unknown batch state as 'unknown' has lost the difference between SEALED and ABANDONED.

candidate_count.description: Drawn candidates. A count, not a page total: MOS-API-016 forbids a total count on a collection endpoint, and this is a column on the batch rather than a scan.

dataset_version_id.description: Set when MOS-TRAIN-082 seals a DatasetVersion from the batch; null before that. harvest_batches_sealed_version_ck makes SEALED and a null dataset_version_id mutually exclusive.

opened_by.description: The principal that opened the batch. A user id, not a name: MOS-API-006 forbids a direct identifier in any response body.

sealed_at.description: harvest_batches_sealed_at_ck: non-null if and only if state is SEALED.
